import itertools
data=open('/workspace/output','rb').read().strip()
def syms(b): return [(b>>(6-2*i))&3 for i in range(4)]
def fromsyms(s): return (s[0]<<6)|(s[1]<<4)|(s[2]<<2)|s[3]
for perm in itertools.permutations(range(4)):
    # inverse map: output symbol -> input symbol
    inv=[0]*4
    for i,p in enumerate(perm): inv[p]=i
    out=bytes(fromsyms([inv[s] for s in syms(c)]) for c in data)
    if all(32<=c<127 for c in out): print(perm,out)
print('done')
